correction_to_batch_072: Batch 072 (sheet 0227) said the minus in the numerator of (f(z_0 + h) - f(z_0))/h 'is a proper math minus'. That was read at sheet scale and is wrong. Measured on sheet 0229 slot 1 (rowink, delta 60): the minus bar is 12-14 px wide against the plus bar's 16 px in the same numerator, so it is the L1 short minus. Recorded below as an L1 recurrence. Batch 072 is kept unchanged.

findings.text: Recurs throughout chapter 06: in the difference quotient (f(z_0 + h) - f(z_0))/h (on screen from 10.0 s to the end of 06_4) the minus bar is 12-14 px wide against the plus bar's 16 px in the same numerator (sheet 0229 slot 1; 4x crop s0229-slot1-quotminus4x.png). Also in 'v_y - i u_y' (06_5, from 86.967 s) and in the boxed Cauchy-Riemann equation 'v_x = -u_y' (06_6, from 103.6 s), where the minus is 14 px wide and 3 rows thick against '=' bars 18 px wide and 1-2 rows thick (sheet 0237 slot 5). In TeX the minus has the same width as the plus and the equals sign.
Recurs in the 06_5 note 'u_x is how fast u changes as x changes' (from 81.1 s): u and x in the prose are upright, while the formulas around it set them italic.
